title: Rafael Jodar says 'still learning' after swearing at ballboy

blocks.text: SHANGHAI–Rising Spanish tennis star Rafael Jodar said he was still “learning how to behave on court” after swearing at a ballboy at the Shanghai Masters, where he reached the semi-finals on Friday to make history. The 20-year-old recovered from a set down to beat Norway’s Casper Ruud 4-6, 6-4, 6-3 and become the youngest player to make the last four in the tournament’s history. It was Jodar’s first match since being warned for unsportsmanlike conduct after shouting an expletive at a ballboy in the fourth round. “I was just frustrated with myself and I couldn’t control my emotions at that point […]...
